description: Phase A E2E benchmark: OrchKvCache full-stack latency (init → prefill → decode → evict → promote)
hardware: NVIDIA A100-SXM4-80GB, 376GB DDR4 DRAM, pinned memory enabled

prefill.note: 512 blocks × 32KB = 16MB H2D, each block: slab_alloc + cudaMemcpyAsync (K) + sync + cudaMemcpyAsync (V) + sync

decode.note: Per step: 32 layers × 8 heads × 2 transfers (K+V) per head = 512 small cudaMemcpyAsync calls

evict_to_dram.note: 32KB D2H per block via async transfer + sync

promote_to_gpu.note: 32KB H2D per block via async transfer + sync

analysis.conclusion: Phase A demonstrates functional correctness with sub-ms evict/promote. Decode overhead is dominated by per-head synchronous transfers; Phase B can optimize with batched async transfers.
